question: What difference in recitation value is assigned to ordinary beads versus ruby beads?
premises: Recitation with beads is measured as a hundred thousand.
Recitation with ruby is declared endless.
The verse states these valuations explicitly.
inference: Using ruby beads is taught to confer an immeasurably greater recitation value than ordinary beads.
uncertainties: Whether māṇikyā refers to a single ruby bead or ruby material is not fully explicit.
plain_english: With beads it is said to be a hundred thousand; with ruby it is said to be endless.
